summary_en: Wacoal Holdings executed off-hours share buyback of 1.4 million shares at ¥3,999 per share on November 16, 2026, totaling ¥5.598 billion, representing 2.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Wacoal Holdings announced the execution of an off-hours share buyback through ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, at a fixed price of ¥3,999 per share. The company acquired 1.4 million shares in aggregate, totaling ¥5.598 billion, which represents 2.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock (calculated from 1,400,000 shares ÷ 49,500,000 shares outstanding). The buyback order was placed on November 13, 2026 at the morning session closing price of ¥3,999 and executed during the 8:45 a.m. ToSTNeT-3 trading session the following morning, with results to be announced after the trading session closed.

This execution is part of a broader authorization approved by the board of directors on November 12, 2026, which authorized the company to acquire up to 5.5 million shares (11.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥20 billion over a twelve-month period from November 13, 2026 through November 12, 2027. The company stated that the purpose of the buyback is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business environments.
